theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that passes the absolute-trend gate and shows the strongest durability (0.75) with intact trend tag and positive breadth (0.611), suggesting leadership is broad-based rather than a single-name spike. This is a direction lean on the strongest theme, expressed as a conditional — not a claim the detector predicts returns.

Banks is also crowded (crowding_z=1.6), so if the macro backdrop mean-reverts, trend-following discipline on China A-shares has historically failed to cut drawdown here.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is mean-revert tagged, not trend eligible, with weak durability (0.23) and middling breadth (0.3) — exactly the profile the trend gate is designed to screen out. Given the detector's only claimed edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate, leaning away from a mean-revert theme that failed the gate is consistent discipline.
theses.dissent: On a mean-reverting tape the trend gate itself failed here, so shunning mean-revert themes on the grounds of trend discipline may be applying a broken rule backward; Coal could pop on an unscheduled policy headline.
